# Velt

> Velt is the collaboration stack for B2B products: a real-time and async collaboration SDK for comments, live cursors, notifications, recordings, and related features. This site (velt.dev) is the marketing site; implementation guides and API reference live on docs.velt.dev.

**Scope:** Use these pages for positioning, pricing, customer proof, feature marketing, integrations, and migration narratives. For install steps, SDK APIs, and code samples, prefer [Velt documentation](https://docs.velt.dev/).

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://velt.dev/): Product positioning and collaboration stack overview
- [Features](https://velt.dev/features): Feature index and deep links into individual feature stories
- [Pricing](https://velt.dev/pricing): Plans and packaging
- [Book a demo](https://velt.dev/book-demo): Sales-led evaluation
- [Enterprise](https://velt.dev/enterprise): Enterprise programs and requirements

## Product depth

- [Customization](https://velt.dev/customization): White-label and custom UI patterns
- [Use cases](https://velt.dev/use-case): Industry and workflow-oriented pages (Sanity-backed slugs under `/use-case/{slug}`)
- [Libraries](https://velt.dev/libraries): Editor and framework integrations (detail at `/libraries/{slug}`)
- [Integrations](https://velt.dev/integrations): Third-party and data integrations (detail at `/integrations/{slug}`)
- [Comparison](https://velt.dev/comparison): Competitive positioning
